content.short: Hype Fisher is a fishing game where players catch unique fish, complete collections, upgrade perks, and earn rewards.
content.description: Hype Fisher focuses on collection-driven fishing gameplay. Players catch different fish, complete sets, exchange collections for rewards, and upgrade perks to improve earnings, giving it a simple Telegram-friendly loop around fishing progress. Catch unique fish, complete collections and exchange them for rewards. Hype Fisher connects to TON through Telegram distribution, on-chain assets, token rewards, wallet-connected play, or community mechanics. The Web3 layer matters because ownership, rewards, Telegram distribution, or token mechanics are part of the loop.
